frozen_predictions.statement: DS mode selects source3 at any fresh competitive offer unless the four-competitive-accept escape is due
held complete AR packet remains unchanged through acceptance even if another source becomes valid
every DDR R follows accepted AR FIFO order in both modes; no old debt can be removed by selector
if actual first-offer sequences and admission times are identical, full event traces and completion vectors must also be identical under this deterministic same-service contract

not_predicted: no numeric speedup; task-level positive/negative/holdout predictions require a separate complete graph and are not counted passed by these protocol checks
completion: 2 real issue/done per lane,8192 read and write bytes per lane,full source/destination bytes and unused guard,AW/B and AR/R conservation,natural completion,no STOP,final quiet,offline byte-check consumer
